items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 69:1
items.html: The two points of the Tzere hint at Hochma and Bina at the time when Bina is at the back of Hochma, and they have no point of Daat beneath them to couple them, as in Answer 67 above. And the Segol hints that there is the point of Daat beneath the Hochma and Bina that couples Hochma and Bina face to face. (Page 313, Item 42; and in Or Pnimi, s.v. 'punctuated').
